title: Can I BEAT Cross Derby? (NEW Variant)
summary: chess.com variant Cross Derby (new at the time): each king sits alone on a corner square cut off by holes, the armies are knights and pawns, pawns promote to knights; checks cannot be blocked. Four wins vs humans (last vs ~2000).
rules: King stuck in a corner (a1 / h8), cut off by off-board holes (0:01, 1:39).
Armies: knights + pawns; pawns promote only to knights (0:05).
Checkmate wins; a knight check can only be met by capturing the checker.
win_condition: Checkmate the cornered king. Goal: win 3 games.
